description.translate: Bring sixteen spruce planks. The upper gallery has gaps, and the watch room has lost part of its shelter. Before I ask anyone to keep watch, they need a safe place to stand. Hand the materials to me one at a time.
Mara's safety ledger was not a formality. I signed it because lives depended on those inspections. When the Hearth Engine failed, the signatures survived more neatly than the people who trusted them.
